pages.title: Pulsed Magnet Lab
pages.text: A coil of Bitter plates and a room of capacitors dumped into it: a field of up to a hundred tesla, for a few milliseconds.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the turns, the current and how long the pulse lasts. The field is B = μ₀NI/L. Every storey adds copper and cooling to the coil. All that current heats it (ΔT ∝ NI²t/size) - past 400 K it melts - and past 100 T the magnetic pressure tears it apart.

pages.name: Pulsed Magnet Lab
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Magnetar Crust Fragment, Magnetic Monopole, Magnetite, Samarium-Cobalt Magnet.
